title: Strict local dimension drop in a nowhere dense closed fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be locally of finite type and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $t\in T$. Suppose the inverse image of $i(Z)$ in the ordinary fibre $X_t$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] has empty interior. For every $z\in Z$ with $(f\circ i)(z)=t$, the local topological dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] of $Z_t$ at $z$ is strictly smaller than the local topological dimension of $X_t$ at $i(z)$.

source.place: Tag 054X, final dimension contradiction; Tag 00OT (lemma-dimension-at-a-point-finite-type-over-field) and Tag 00OS, local dimension and finite type domain dimension.

proof.text: Work in an affine neighbourhood of i(z) in the finite type scheme X_t over the residue field. Its closed inverse image in Z_t is affine and finite type over the same field. The affine local-dimension component formula expresses the dimension at each point as the maximum of the dimensions of components through that point.

Each closed-fibre component maps to a closed irreducible subset of an ambient component. Empty interior excludes equality with an ambient component, since the finite union of the other ambient components has open complement meeting that component. Append the ambient component to a maximal irreducible chain in the proper closed subset to obtain a strict dimension inequality.

The closed-fibre component dimensions are bounded strictly by dimensions of ambient components through i(z). Finite type over a field gives finite dimensions, and there are finitely many components. Taking the finite attained maximum and using locality gives the asserted strict inequality.

theorem fibre_dimension_lt_of_closed_interior_eq_empty
    {Z X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (t : T)
    (h : interior ((f.fiberι t) ⁻¹' Set.range i) = ∅)
    (z : Z) (hz : (i ≫ f) z = t) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt ((i ≫ f).asFiber z) <
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (i z))
